message.text:
h15.

Visibility is enforced at multiple independent surfaces rather than one chokepoint. Every distinct site:

`(*APIV1Service).checkMemoReadAccess` (single-memo read gate; used by `GetMemo` at line 356, parent-memo check at 367, and `ListMemoComments` at 148) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39`
`(*APIV1Service).ListMemos` (injects `VisibilityList` / CEL filter so the SQL never returns invisible rows) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:219-225`
`(*APIV1Service).ListMemoComments` (comment-list filter) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:158-160`
`(*APIV1Service).CreateMemoComment` (blocks commenting on a private memo you don't own; also forces comment visibility relative to parent) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:41` and `:100`
`(*APIV1Service).ListMemoRelations` (filters related memos) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:109-111`
`(*APIV1Service).batchConvertMemoRelations` (filters relations during response conversion) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:184-186`
`(*APIV1Service).ListMemoReactions` — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:30-38`
`(*APIV1Service).UpsertMemoReaction` — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:83`
`(*APIV1Service).DeleteMemoReaction` — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:135`
`(*APIV1Service).checkAttachmentAccess` (attachment access follows the linked memo's visibility; called from `GetAttachment` at line 255) — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:436-451`
`(*APIV1Service).ListMemoAttachments` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:214-222`
`(*APIV1Service).ListAllUserStats` — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:84-90`
`(*APIV1Service).GetUserStats` — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:218-220`
`(*SSEClient).canReceive` (server-side event delivery filtering; `SSEEvent.Visibility` exists solely for this) — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:135` (field at `:32`)
`(*FileServerService).checkAttachmentPermission` (raw HTTP file serving, outside gRPC) — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:677` and `:699`
`(*RSSService).GetExploreRSS` and `(*RSSService).GetUserRSS` (both restrict to `store.Public`) — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90` and `:141`
`(*FrontendService).getSitemapXML` (public-only URLs) — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150`
`(*APIV1Service).buildMentionNotificationTargets` (won't notify non-owners about private memos) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:62`, `:67`, `:84`
Email notification body redaction (`Private` and `Protected` memos have content withheld) — `server/notification/email.go:313-316` and `server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:309-312`

Two structural notes. The API layer uses two different mechanisms: list endpoints push visibility into the query as a CEL filter string like `creator_id == %d || visibility in ["PUBLIC", "PROTECTED"]`, while single-object endpoints do an explicit post-fetch check; the ACL comment at `server/router/api/v1/acl_config.go:32` records that this is intentional ("visibility filtering done in service layer") since the ACL allowlist itself permits anonymous access to memo endpoints.

The file server is the one surface with an extra bypass: `checkAttachmentPermission` accepts a `share_token` query parameter and grants access to a private or protected memo's attachments when the token matches a non-expired `MemoShare` for that exact memo (`fileserver.go:684-689`). Notably `server/router/api/v1/memo_share_service.go` contains no visibility check of its own.
